verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk-operations feature, such as selecting many incidents, alerts or schedules and acting on them at once. The general API ("anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI") and the MCP server are developer building blocks for scripting such actions. The Signals Migrator is a one-time config import, and Runbooks automate per-incident steps; both are adjacent features, not native bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
